title: The 3x+1 conjugacy map
notes: Canadian Journal of Mathematics 48 (1996), 1154-1169. Read directly from the publisher PDF on 22 September 2026, especially equations (1.5), (1.6), (4.2) and the introduction's rationality distinction. Applying the inverse parity map to a Juggler itinerary and negating gives H(n) = sum_j 2^d_j / 3^(j+1) in Z_2, with H(J(n)) = C_-(H(n)). This is a universal symbolic construction, not a new arithmetic theorem. H(3) = 83/27 refutes transport of all positive integers into ordinary integers; H(4) = H(6) = 4 refutes injectivity. For periodic words the value is wordConst/(3^o-2^K), the existing rational-cycle formula. Paper B's fixed-depth fair-share hypothesis becomes equidistribution of these codes modulo every power of two. Review recorded in docs/problems/juggler_collatz_bridge.md; pure coding route CLOSE.
